prompt: 我在 procurement-portal 页面给返回首页按钮加了 style={{background:'#ffffff', boxShadow:'0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'}}, 但看起来和首页风格不搭，而且 hover 没反应了。怎么修？

assertions.text: 诊断出内联 style 优先级高于 :hover 选择器（hover 失效根因）
assertions.name: identifies-inline-specificity

assertions.text: 识别出 0 4px 20px rgba 是错误的扁平/omnidirectional shadow
assertions.name: identifies-flat-shadow

assertions.text: 正确修复：删除内联 style，依赖 .flow-back 类
assertions.name: fix-removes-inline-style

assertions.text: 指出阴影应用 oklch(0.55 0.03 258) 而非 rgba(0,0,0)
assertions.name: mentions-oklch-requirement

assertions.text: 提及 inset 0 1px 0 内高光线这一关键细节
assertions.name: mentions-inner-highlight
